prompt: Please use the attached full-body person image as the visual reference. [Person] For the person in the reference image, maintain the face, expression, hair, perceived age, body type, height, head-to-body ratio, and overall proportions exactly. Do not infer, correct, or redesign these from text; consistently reflect the person seen in the reference image in all views. If the reference is a photograph, convert it into a high-quality anime representation without changing the person's characteristics or proportions. If the reference is an illustration or anime, maintain the character design and drawing style as is, and do not change it to realistic or a different art style. Do not inherit the clothing, shoes, accessories, jewelry, hair ornaments, belts, bags, pose, background, floor, or lighting from the reference image. Replace them completely. [Outfit] A deep ruby wine red off-shoulder fit-and-flare A-line dress that maintains brightness and vividness. The color should be clearly red with a slight hint of Bordeaux, not brown, black, or dark maroon. Place medium-sized ivory white polka dots evenly with wide spacing, not crowded. Features an off-shoulder neck showing both shoulders and collarbones, short simple sleeves along the shoulders, a bodice that naturally follows the body, a waist narrowed by tailoring, and a symmetrical smooth flared A-line. No belt. The hem should be near the lower thigh, 8-10 cm above the knee, not a mid-thigh mini length. Include safety shorts of the same color inside, but not visible in a standing posture. No ruffles, puff sleeves, ribbons, jackets, separate tops, wrap structures, pleats, or asymmetrical designs. Shoes are deep ruby wine red, matching the dress. Closed-toe T-strap shoes with a non-slender almond toe, thin vertical strap, thin ankle strap, low 2-3 cm block heel, and small silver buckle. No sneakers, lace-ups, thick athletic soles, open toes, sandals, or high heels. [Layout] Generate one high-design character style sheet in 1:1 square at the highest resolution. Place a full-body three-view of the same person in a horizontal row in the top 65%. Left is front full-body with heading '01 FRONT', center is profile with heading '02 SIDE', right is back with heading '03 BACK'. Align them to the same floor baseline, character size, camera distance, and viewpoint height in a natural standing posture, shown from head to toe without cropping. The three-view should show the same person rotated under the same conditions. Do not change the face, hair, age, body type, height, or proportions for each angle. Ensure the dress color, dot size/spacing, shoulder position, waist position, hem length, and shoe structure are consistent. In the bottom 35%, elegantly place a white ruled notebook, black metal pen, silver paperclip, and white eraser as independent design elements on the left. Do not have the character hold them or depict events with the character. In the bottom center to right, place the same person's face from three angles: front, 3/4 view, and profile at the same magnification. Show the same dress at the shoulder. On the far right, place a vertical color palette of five colors: dress wine red, polka dot ivory, representative skin and hair colors from the reference, and metallic silver. [Design and Quality] Background is white to warm ivory. Use a very thin paper texture, subtle ruled line motif, thin dividers, and ample white space to create a sophisticated fashion editorial style starring the top three-view. Clearly draw the face, eyes, hair, fingers, dress outline, dots, hem, shoe straps, and buckles while maintaining the drawing style of the reference image. Avoid blurring, low resolution, ambiguous outlines, changing the person's identity, altering characteristics per angle, incorrect outfits, remaining artifacts from the original, extra people beyond the specified six views, extra limbs, body deformation, long text, dialogue, logos, or watermarks. The only text in the image should be the three headings '01 FRONT', '02 SIDE', and '03 BACK'.
